name: squirex
description: Agent-security scanner for Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow Now Assist, MuleSoft Agent Fabric, and MCP servers.

interface.longDescription: SquireX scans AI-agent metadata and code for capability, privilege, prompt-injection, and supply-chain issues across Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow Now Assist, MuleSoft Agent Fabric, and MCP servers. This plugin package runs a local stdio MCP server; the hosted HTTPS MCP connector for the OpenAI public directory is a separate listing. Entitlements for private repos are checked via a SquireX license key — checkout stays on squirex.dev.
